input.command:
cat > /etc/supervisor/conf.d/gunicorn.conf <<'EOF'
[program:gunicorn]
directory=/testbed
command=/usr/local/bin/gunicorn --workers 3 --bind unix:/tmp/gunicorn.sock app:app
autostart=true
autorestart=true
startsecs=2
stopsignal=TERM
stdout_logfile=/var/log/gunicorn.out.log
stderr_logfile=/var/log/gunicorn.err.log
user=root
EOF
mkdir -p /var/run/supervisor /var/log/supervisor
supervisord -c /etc/supervisor/supervisord.conf
sleep 4
supervisorctl -c /etc/supervisor/supervisord.conf status
